name: Phinehas (son of Eli)
title: Wicked Priest at Shiloh
summary: Phinehas was one of the two sons of the high priest Eli. Together with his brother Hophni, he disgraced the priesthood at Shiloh and despised the Lord's offerings. Both fell on the same day in battle against the Philistines when God's ark of the covenant was captured.

keyEvents.title: Fell When the Ark Was Captured
keyEvents.description: Hophni and Phinehas were killed on the same day the Philistines defeated Israel and took God's ark of the covenant, just as God's word had foretold.
